title: Provider Availability Settings
description: The full-screen availability settings view within the portal where a provider connects Gmail calendars, sets recurring weekly hours, and adds date overrides, returning to the dashboard on save.
html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  .avail-root {
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr;
    grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
    background: #0f0e1a;
    color: #fff;
  }

  .dash-topnav {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0 32px;
    height: 60px;
    background: rgba(15,14,26,0.95);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 10;
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  }

  .dash-topnav__left {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 20px;
  }

  .dash-topnav__wordmark { opacity: 0.85; }

  .dash-topnav__divider {
    width: 1px;
    height: 20px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  }

  .dash-topnav__breadcrumb {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .dash-topnav__breadcrumb a {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  .dash-topnav__breadcrumb a:hover { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); }

  .dash-topnav__breadcrumb__sep { opacity: 0.3; }

  .dash-topnav__breadcrumb__current {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .dash-topnav__right {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .dash-topnav__name {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
  }

  .dash-topnav__avatar {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.2);
    border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.3);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #a78bfa;
  }

  .dash-sidebar {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #141222 0%, #110f1f 100%);
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 28px 0;
    gap: 4px;
  }

  .dash-sidebar__section {
    padding: 0 16px 16px;
  }

  .dash-nav-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 9px 12px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    border: none;
    background: none;
    width: 100%;
    text-align: left;
    font-family: inherit;
  }

  .dash-nav-item:hover {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  }

  .dash-nav-item[data-active="true"] {
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.12);
    color: #c4b5fd;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .dash-nav-item__icon {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    opacity: 0.7;
  }

  .dash-nav-item[data-active="true"] .dash-nav-item__icon { opacity: 1; }

  .dash-nav-item__badge {
    margin-left: auto;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 2px 7px;
    border-radius: 100px;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.2);
    color: #a78bfa;
  }

  .sidebar-stage {
    margin: 0 16px 24px;
    padding: 14px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    border-radius: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .sidebar-stage__label {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
  }

  .sidebar-stage__name {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
  }

  .sidebar-stage__track { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
  .sidebar-stage__step { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; }

  .sidebar-stage__dot {
    width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .sidebar-stage__dot[data-state="done"] { background: #4ade80; }
  .sidebar-stage__dot[data-state="active"] { background: #a78bfa; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(167,139,250,0.2); }
  .sidebar-stage__dot[data-state="review"] { background: #f59e0b; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(245,158,11,0.15); }
  .sidebar-stage__dot[data-state="pending"] { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }

  .sidebar-stage__step-label[data-state="done"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); text-decoration: line-through; }
  .sidebar-stage__step-label[data-state="active"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); font-weight: 600; }
  .sidebar-stage__step-label[data-state="review"] { color: rgba(245,158,11,0.75); }
  .sidebar-stage__step-label[data-state="pending"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }

  /* MAIN */
  .avail-main {
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 40px 52px 80px;
    background: #0f0e1a;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 32px;
  }

  /* Page header */
  .avail-page-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 24px;
  }

  .avail-page-header__left {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .avail-page-header__back {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-weight: 500;
    padding: 0;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    transition: color 0.15s;
  }

  .avail-page-header__back:hover { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); }

  .avail-page-header__eyebrow {
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
  }

  .avail-page-header__title {
    font-size: 26px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    color: #fff;
  }

  .avail-page-header__sub {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
    line-height: 1.5;
    max-width: 540px;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }

  .avail-page-header__actions {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-top: 38px;
  }

  .avail-btn-secondary {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 10px 18px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
    font-family: inherit;
    transition: all 0.15s;
  }

  .avail-btn-secondary:hover {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.09);
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  }

  .avail-btn-primary {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 10px 20px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: #7c3aed;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: inherit;
    transition: background 0.15s;
  }

  .avail-btn-primary:hover { background: #6d28d9; }

  /* Three-column layout */
  .avail-layout {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 300px;
    gap: 24px;
    align-items: start;
  }

  /* Section card */
  .avail-section {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    border-radius: 18px;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .avail-section__header {
    padding: 20px 22px 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
  }

  .avail-section__overline {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .avail-section__title {
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
  }

  .avail-section__desc {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
    line-height: 1.5;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }

  .avail-section__badge {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 3px 9px;
    border-radius: 100px;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.15);
    color: #a78bfa;
    white-space: nowrap;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .avail-section__badge[data-color="green"] {
    background: rgba(74,222,128,0.12);
    color: #86efac;
  }

  .avail-section__body {
    padding: 20px 22px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 14px;
  }

  /* Calendar connection */
  .calendar-connected {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 14px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    background: rgba(74,222,128,0.06);
    border: 1px solid rgba(74,222,128,0.18);
    border-radius: 12px;
  }

  .calendar-connected__icon {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: rgba(74,222,128,0.12);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .calendar-connected__text {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
  }

  .calendar-connected__email {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
  }

  .calendar-connected__status {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #86efac;
  }

  .calendar-connected__remove {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    padding: 4px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 13px;
    transition: color 0.15s;
  }

  .calendar-connected__remove:hover { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); }

  .calendar-add-btn {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    border-radius: 11px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    border: 1.5px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    font-family: inherit;
    transition: all 0.15s;
  }

  .calendar-add-btn:hover {
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.06);
    border-color: rgba(167,139,250,0.25);
    color: #c4b5fd;
  }

  .gmail-notice {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    border-radius: 10px;
  }

  .gmail-notice__text {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .gmail-notice__text strong {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
  }

  /* Weekly hours grid */
  .hours-grid {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0;
  }

  .hours-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 80px 1fr auto;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 10px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  }

  .hours-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

  .hours-row__day {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
  }

  .hours-row__day[data-active="true"] {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
  }

  .hours-row__times {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .hours-time-input {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 7px 12px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
    font-family: inherit;
    width: 90px;
    text-align: center;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .hours-time-input[data-active="true"] {
    border-color: rgba(167,139,250,0.4);
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.06);
    color: #c4b5fd;
  }

  .hours-time-sep {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
  }

  .hours-row__toggle-wrap {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .hours-row__toggle-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .hours-row[data-inactive="true"] .hours-row__times {
    opacity: 0.25;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* Custom toggle styling matching design system pattern */
  .avail-toggle {
    width: 40px;
    height: 24px;
    border-radius: 100px;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 3px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    transition: background 0.2s;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  }

  .avail-toggle[data-on="true"] {
    background: #7c3aed;
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }

  .avail-toggle[data-on="false"] {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }

  .avail-toggle__handle {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #fff;
  }

  /* Date overrides */
  .override-list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .override-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 11px 14px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    border-radius: 10px;
  }

  .override-row__date {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
    width: 100px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .override-row__type {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    border-radius: 5px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .override-row__type[data-kind="unavailable"] {
    background: rgba(239,68,68,0.12);
    color: rgba(252,165,165,0.8);
  }

  .override-row__type[data-kind="modified"] {
    background: rgba(251,191,36,0.1);
    color: rgba(253,230,138,0.8);
  }

  .override-row__label {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
    flex: 1;
  }

  .override-row__remove {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    font-size: 16px;
    padding: 2px 4px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-family: inherit;
    transition: color 0.15s;
  }

  .override-row__remove:hover { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); }

  .override-add-btn {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 7px;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    border: 1.5px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
    font-family: inherit;
    transition: all 0.15s;
  }

  .override-add-btn:hover {
    border-color: rgba(167,139,250,0.2);
    color: rgba(167,139,250,0.7);
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.04);
  }

  /* Sidebar guidance */
  .avail-sidebar {
    position: sticky;
    top: 80px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 14px;
  }

  .avail-guidance-card {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    border-radius: 14px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .avail-guidance-card__header {
    padding: 13px 16px 11px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .avail-guidance-card__icon {
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.12);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .avail-guidance-card__title {
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
  }

  .avail-guidance-card__body {
    padding: 13px 16px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 9px;
  }

  .avail-guidance-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.38);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .avail-guidance-item__dot {
    width: 5px;
    height: 5px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.4);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-top: 6px;
  }

  .avail-guidance-item strong {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.62);
  }

  /* Status widget */
  .avail-status-widget {
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.06);
    border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.15);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 16px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .avail-status-widget__label {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(167,139,250,0.55);
  }

  .avail-status-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  .avail-status-row__label { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }

  .avail-status-row__val {
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 11px;
  }

  .avail-status-row__val[data-done="true"] { color: #86efac; }
  .avail-status-row__val[data-done="false"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }

  .avail-status-divider {
    height: 1px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  }

  .avail-status-note {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  /* Bottom save bar */
  .avail-save-bar {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 240px;
    right: 0;
    height: 64px;
    background: rgba(15,14,26,0.96);
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0 52px;
    z-index: 9;
  }

  .avail-save-bar__left {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
  }

  .avail-save-bar__indicator {
    width: 7px;
    height: 7px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(245,158,11,0.8);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .avail-save-bar__actions {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
  }
</style>

<div class="avail-root" data-el="avail-root">

  <!-- TOP NAV -->
  <nav class="dash-topnav" data-el="topnav">
    <div class="dash-topnav__left">
      <div class="dash-topnav__wordmark" data-el="topnav-wordmark">
        <span class="wordmark" data-size="md">
          <svg class="wordmark__svg" role="img" aria-label="thoughtful" width="110" height="24" viewBox="0 0 159 34" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                </button>

              <div class="override-row" data-el="override-2">
                <span class="override-row__date">Dec 25, 2024</span>
                <span class="override-row__type" data-kind="unavailable">Unavailable</span>
                <span class="override-row__label">Holiday — no bookings</span>
                <button class="override-row__remove" aria-label="Remove date override">
                  <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/></svg>
                </button>
              </div>
              <div class="override-row" data-el="override-3">
                <span class="override-row__date">Jan 2, 2025</span>
                <span class="override-row__type" data-kind="modified">Modified</span>
                <span class="override-row__label">12:00 PM – 4:00 PM only</span>
                <button class="override-row__remove" aria-label="Remove date override">
                  <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/></svg>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button class="override-add-btn" data-el="add-override-btn" style="margin-top:10px;width:100%;">
              <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg>
              Add a date override
            </button>
          </div>

        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- COL 3: Guidance sidebar -->
      <div class="avail-sidebar" data-el="avail-sidebar">

        <!-- Setup status -->
        <div class="avail-status-widget" data-el="setup-status">
          <span class="avail-status-widget__label">Availability status</span>
          <div class="avail-status-row">
            <span class="avail-status-row__label">Gmail calendar</span>
            <span class="avail-status-row__val" data-done="true">Connected</span>
          </div>
          <div class="avail-status-row">
            <span class="avail-status-row__label">Weekly hours</span>
            <span class="avail-status-row__val" data-done="true">Set · 5 days</span>
          </div>
          <div class="avail-status-row">
            <span class="avail-status-row__label">Date overrides</span>
            <span class="avail-status-row__val" data-done="true">3 added</span>
          </div>
          <div class="avail-status-divider"></div>
          <span class="avail-status-note">Save your settings to move to Step 3. You can update your hours and calendars at any time from this page.</span>
        </div>

        <!-- How availability works -->
        <div class="avail-guidance-card" data-el="guidance-how-it-works">
          <div class="avail-guidance-card__header">
            <div class="avail-guidance-card__icon">
              <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="color:#a78bfa;" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 8v4"/><path d="M12 16h.01"/></svg>
            </div>
            <span class="avail-guidance-card__title">How this works</span>
          </div>
          <div class="avail-guidance-card__body">
            <div class="avail-guidance-item">
              <div class="avail-guidance-item__dot"></div>
              <span>Your <strong>weekly hours</strong> set when members can book with you — slots outside these hours won't appear in Provider Booking.</span>
            </div>
            <div class="avail-guidance-item">
              <div class="avail-guidance-item__dot"></div>
              <span>Your <strong>connected Gmail calendars</strong> are checked for existing events — existing events block those slots automatically.</span>
            </div>
            <div class="avail-guidance-item">
              <div class="avail-guidance-item__dot"></div>
              <span><strong>Date overrides</strong> let you mark specific days as unavailable (time off) or set different hours (shorter day).</span>
            </div>
            <div class="avail-guidance-item">
              <div class="avail-guidance-item__dot"></div>
              <span>Cal.com runs behind the scenes. <strong>You never need to go there directly</strong> — all changes happen here in the portal.</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- First Bookable Date note -->
        <div class="avail-guidance-card" data-el="guidance-first-bookable">
          <div class="avail-guidance-card__header">
            <div class="avail-guidance-card__icon">
              <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="color:#a78bfa;" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="16" y1="2" x2="16" y2="6"/><line x1="8" y1="2" x2="8" y2="6"/><line x1="3" y1="10" x2="21" y2="10"/></svg>
            </div>
            <span class="avail-guidance-card__title">First Bookable Date</span>
          </div>
          <div class="avail-guidance-card__body">
            <div class="avail-guidance-item">
              <div class="avail-guidance-item__dot"></div>
              <span>Your <strong>First Bookable Date</strong> is set by the team when they mark you live — not by your availability settings.</span>
            </div>
            <div class="avail-guidance-item">
              <div class="avail-guidance-item__dot"></div>
              <span>Members can see your profile before that date but the <strong>earliest slot they can book is on or after it.</strong></span>
            </div>
            <div class="avail-guidance-item">
              <div class="avail-guidance-item__dot"></div>
              <span>Availability must be complete before the team can set your First Bookable Date. <strong>Finish this step now</strong> so nothing delays your go-live.</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Notice period -->
        <div class="avail-guidance-card" data-el="guidance-notice">
          <div class="avail-guidance-card__header">
            <div class="avail-guidance-card__icon">
              <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="color:#a78bfa;" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><polyline points="12 6 12 12 16 14"/></svg>
            </div>
            <span class="avail-guidance-card__title">Minimum notice period (optional)</span>
          </div>
          <div class="avail-guidance-card__body">
            <div class="avail-guidance-item">
              <div class="avail-guidance-item__dot"></div>
              <span>You can optionally set a <strong>minimum notice period</strong> — the shortest time before a session that a member can book.</span>
            </div>
            <div class="avail-guidance-item">
              <div class="avail-guidance-item__dot"></div>
              <span>This isn't required for go-live. If you want to set one, contact the provider ops team — it will be available directly in the portal in a later update.</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>

    </div>

    <!-- Spacer for fixed save bar -->
    <div style="height:32px;"></div>

  </main>

  <!-- Fixed bottom save bar -->
  <div class="avail-save-bar" data-el="save-bar">
    <div class="avail-save-bar__left" data-el="save-bar-status">
      <div class="avail-save-bar__indicator"></div>
      Unsaved changes — your availability hasn't been saved yet
    </div>
    <div class="avail-save-bar__actions">
      <button class="avail-btn-secondary" data-el="discard-btn">Discard changes</button>
      <button class="avail-btn-primary" data-el="primary-cta">
        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg>
        Save availability & continue
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
name: Provider Availability Settings
